customer.business: Capabble, a modular cloud school ERP for Indian K-12 schools
customer.target: the person who decides on school software at a private CBSE-affiliated school in North India with 300 to 2,000 students (principal, owner/trustee or school administrator). NOTE: every money amount in this brief is in Indian rupees (INR), even where a $ sign is printed, and your own income is your personal yearly salary or draw in rupees
customer.where: North India (Haryana, Delhi NCR, Punjab, UP)

segments.name: Principal of a mid-size private CBSE school (600-1,200 students)
Owner/trustee of a small private school (300-600 students, fees under Rs 3,000 a month)
Administrator or accounts head at a large school or a 2-3 school trust (1,200-2,000+ students)
Exam-centre superintendent / senior teacher at a school that is a CBSE board exam centre

behaviours.name: Already on an incumbent ERP
behaviours.how: Pays a yearly AMC to an established school ERP vendor; switching means migrating years of fee and student data.

behaviours.name: Excel + WhatsApp + Tally
behaviours.how: Runs fees in Tally or Excel, sends notices on WhatsApp groups, has never paid for school software.

behaviours.name: Price-first negotiator
behaviours.how: Asks every vendor for a discount and a free demo at the school; compares per-student price.

behaviours.name: Wants a person to set it up
behaviours.how: Will only buy if someone comes to the school, trains the staff and imports the data.

behaviours.name: Exam-season pain buyer
behaviours.how: Buys tools when a deadline hurts: board exams, timetable at session start, report cards.

behaviours.name: Asks the network
behaviours.how: Asks principals of nearby schools and the trust's chairman what they use before deciding.

objections: Rs 60,000 a year plus GST is a lot when we already pay for software or use Excel for free
Who will train my staff and enter our data? My office staff are not comfortable with computers
A new company with a small team - what if it shuts down and we lose our data?
Will parents actually use the app, and is it in Hindi?
Our current ERP works well enough; switching mid-session is risky
We only need fees and attendance, not 14 modules
Can it handle CBSE requirements like registration, report cards and board-exam centre work?
I need to see it working at a school like ours first
habits: fee collection season at the start of each quarter keeps the office busy for weeks
you spend part of every March running the school as a CBSE board exam centre
the trust chairman signs off any spend above Rs 25,000
you get two or three calls a month from software and ed-tech salespeople
teachers complain about the timetable every April
parents message you on WhatsApp late at night

pitch:
Capabble: school management software for Indian schools, in the browser and as an Android/iOS app for parents and staff.
14 modules - students, fees and payroll, attendance, timetable, internal exams and report cards, CBSE exam-centre control (seating, invigilator duties, Form 66, answer-sheet dispatch), transport, library, assets and more. Buy one module or all of them; they share data.
Complete school: all 14 modules for Rs 60,000 a year + 18% GST, up to 500 students (Rs 120 a year per extra student). Single modules from Rs 4,000 to Rs 12,000 a year. Staff, parent and student logins free.
14-day free trial with your school's data, cancel before it ends and pay nothing. Launch offer: first year half price (Rs 30,000) with code LAUNCH50.
Sign up online at capabble.cloud; pay by UPI, card or bank transfer with GST invoices.
